# Feed URLs the control plane accepts (feedURLProblem in site_validate.go).
#
# Read by two tests, so the two parsers cannot drift apart unnoticed:
#   - TestFeedURLParityFixtureIsAccepted (site_validate_test.go): every line here
#     must pass the control plane's check;
#   - every_url_the_control_plane_accepts_is_fetchable (crates/sentinel-proxy/
#     src/ip_feed.rs): the data plane must accept every line too.
# A URL stored by the console but refused by the data plane fails on every node
# at every refresh while the console shows it as set. Add a line here whenever
# the control-plane check is loosened.
#
# One URL per line; blank lines and lines starting with # are skipped.

https://iplists.firehol.org/files/firehol_level1.netset
http://feeds.example/list
HTTP://10.0.0.5:8080/list.txt
HTTPS://FEEDS.EXAMPLE/list
https://feeds.example:8443/list?key=abc&format=plain
http://[2001:db8::1]/list
http://[2001:db8::1]:8080/list
https://feeds.example
https://feeds.example?x=1
https://feeds_x.example/list
https://xn--bcher-kva.example/list
https://feeds.example/a%20b/%C3%BC.txt
https://feeds.example/a'b(c)*+,;=:@!$&~-._/list
https://feeds.example/l?a=1&b=/?:@[x]
https://feeds.example/[v1]/list
https://feeds.example/list#section
